name: HELLO 40 Cotton Ball Yarn Pack (25g each)
description:
About HELLO Cotton Yarns:

HELLO is a 100% cotton mercerized yarn. It can be used in crochet, knitting and punch embroidery projects. HELLO cotton yarns have the Oeko-Tex Standard 100 Certificate , which certifies that no harmful substances are used in the yarn. It is 100% Turkish and domestic production.

What Can You Do with HELLO?

With HELLO, you can knit amigurumi toys, baby blankets, pillows, accessories, crochet motifs, summer dresses, shawls, cardigans and baby clothes. The most preferred knitting items are baby cardigans, toys and clothes.

  • Crochet hook size: 2.5-3.5.
  • Knitting Needles size: 3

name: 14CT Printed Cross Stitch Kits (Religious)
description:
Kit includes:

 

Notes:

  • Keep your hands clean before stitching.
  • The pattern has been printed on the cloth, so before finishing stitching, the cloth cannot touch water, otherwise the design will fade.
  • After finishing the whole pattern, put the cloth in water (below 30°C) for more than 3 hours till all the printed design fades, then wash it with clean water again.
  • Dry it by leaving it flat in a ventilated place in order to protect the threads from being damaged.
  • Iron the artwork on the back on the fabric with a steam flat iron until it becomes flat.
